title: Tests on Autonomous Public Buses and Inclusion in Public Transport Mix
what_it_is: Tests on Autonomous Public Buses and Inclusion in Public Transport Mix

sections.label: Autonomous public bus fleet progress
sections.summary: NTU and STK trials start in 2019, LTA issued an RFI for AV buses in Punggol, Tengah and Jurong Innovation District.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport what is the progress of work on autonomous public bus fleets in Singapore and when can they be expected to be a part of our public transportation mix.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: These autonomous bus projects are progressing well, with NTU and STK on track to commence trials in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The trials will initially be carried out in a controlled environment at the CETRAN Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Test Centre, before expanding into designated areas with lighter traffic, such as NTU, CleanTech Park and Jurong Island.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Separately, LTA has also issued a request for information (RFI) on the deployment of AV buses in Punggol, Tengah and the Jurong Innovation District.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The pilot deployment is expected to provide important insights into commuter acceptance of AVs and how we can scale up their deployment across Singapore.
